proposals.note: The atlas label resolves to CL:0002131 (regular ventricular cardiac myocyte), while CL also carries CL:2000046 (ventricular cardiac muscle cell). Neither subsumes the other -- there is no `is_a` path in either direction -- though they share ancestors up to cardiocyte, so a cluster assigned to one registers as disagreeing with the other and expression cannot adjudicate between them. Whether a subclass relation belongs here is a curatorial judgement; what the audit establishes is that the relation is absent and that 180,750 cells sit on one side of it.
